name: weather-platform
description: Workspace foundation for the Weather platform

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.lint: node scripts/lint.mjs .editorconfig .gitignore .github .npmrc .nvmrc README.md package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.base.json scripts apps packages
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration --workspace @weather/database && npm run test:integration --workspace @weather/worker && npm run test:integration --workspace @weather/api
